table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname = service.name,
	reprintdate = getDate(),
	users.username,  
	code=dbo.serviceheader.serviceinvcode,  
	serviceocode=serviceheader.serviceocode,
	cashcharged=serviceheader.cashcharged,
	doctorname=(select name from doctors where doctors.doctcode=serviceheader.doctcode), 
	date=dbo.serviceheader.date,  
	dbo.serviceheader.headerno,
	dbo.serviceheader.discperc,   
	dbo.serviceheader.misccharges,   
	dbo.serviceheader.custcode,   
	REMARKS=dbo.serviceheader.remarks,
	dbo.serviceheader.flatdisc,
	reprintcounter = dbo.serviceheader.reprintingcounter,
	dbo.service.servicecode,   
	price = dbo.servicedetail.price, 
	serviceflatdisc = dbo.servicedetail.serviceflatdisc, 
	Qty = dbo.servicedetail.qty,
	servicedetail_discperc = servicedetail.discperc, 
	customername=(SELECT Accounts.Name FROM Accounts WHERE Accounts.AccCode  = serviceheader.Custcode),
	cashaccname=(select name from accounts where accounts.acccode=serviceheader.cashacccode),
	dbo.serviceheader.saleinvcode,
	servicesalecatcode=dbo.serviceheader.servicecatcode,
	tokenno = dbo.serviceheader.tokenno,
	Patient=(SELECT Patient.Name FROM Patient WHERE ServiceHeader.PatientCode = Patient.PatientCode),
	RegNo=(SELECT Patient.Regno FROM Patient WHERE ServiceHeader.PatientCode = Patient.PatientCode),
	patientadd=(SELECT Patient.address1 FROM Patient WHERE ServiceHeader.PatientCode = Patient.PatientCode),
	patientphone=(SELECT Patient.phone FROM Patient WHERE ServiceHeader.PatientCode = Patient.PatientCode),
	usergroupname=(select  groups.groupname from groups,usergroups where  users.usercode=usergroups.usercode and usergroups.groupcode=groups.groupcode),
	patientage=(SELECT Patient.ageyears FROM Patient WHERE ServiceHeader.PatientCode = Patient.PatientCode)
	
FROM 
	dbo.serviceheader LEFT OUTER JOIN Patient ON (dbo.serviceheader.patientcode = patient.patientcode),   
	dbo.servicedetail,  
	service, 
	users
	
WHERE 
	( dbo.serviceheader.serviceinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
	( dbo.serviceheader.serviceinvcode = dbo.servicedetail.serviceinvcode ) AND 
	( dbo.serviceheader.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND
	( servicedetail.servicecode = service.servicecode )
